intent: Draft a 30-second original visual script to test the Meesha reference format with the existing Pencil pipeline.
method: Inspected existing project notes and relevant animation code; authored a timed visual script and checked contiguous 30 fps frame ranges.
result: Eight shots cover 30 seconds and 900 frames. The draft specifies notebook artwork, expressive faces, held poses, gestures, transforms, text, and a visual punchline. No animation rendered.
decision: Script draft prepared for discussion; production and visual match remain untested.

intent: Apply the user instruction to replicate the supplied video characters and environment with the endorsed new script.
method: Revised the existing script into v002, specifying source character designs, timestamped visual targets, reference desk furniture, consistent model selection, and side-by-side visual checks.
result: Preserved v001 and the 30-second story. V002 replaces generic original-character direction with direct reference matching and changes the laptop prop to the reference desktop setup. No animation rendered.
decision: User endorsed the script and explicitly selected matching the source environment and characters; rendered resemblance remains untested.

method: Native Blender editable curves and meshes, traced character proportions, existing Pencil drawing/keyframe helpers, and frame-baked animation.
result: Saved executable build script and extracted front, cast, and desk reference frames before generation.
decision: User said to start; proceed through rendering and verification.

intent: Check initial script execution and native sample frames before delivery.
method: Blender script execution and sampled image inspection.
result: An initial helper-load attempt lacked the PAPER constant. Initial rendered frames then exposed back-hair visibility overwriting prior frames and round limb strokes hiding their white interiors. These attempts were rejected internally and corrected before full rendering.
decision: Resolved helper initialization, independently baked visibility, and stroke depth ordering; not a user rejection.

intent: Verify the reconstructed film and prepare the native render.
method: Reviewed 12 native sample frames and a source/reconstruction head comparison; ran verify_project.py against the saved Blender project.
result: 900 frames at 30 fps, 1920x1080; 591 held-phone contact frames checked in the saved scene with maximum 0.0001221 px anchor error; correct face/back visibility; embedded soundtrack; unchanged Heavy Box source hash. Corrected caption overlaps, seated framing, and retreat path during review.
decision: Proceed with full render. Visual resemblance remains for user assessment; checks do not establish exact pixel identity.

intent: Bring the reconstructed drawing contours closer to the supplied source.
method: Source/reconstruction comparison, stronger thin contours, corrected eye/nose contour junction, native rebuild and rerender.
result: Archived the first complete picture master under artifacts/layout-v001. The revised native scene was reverified and rendered in full.
decision: Proceed with revised picture; no claim of pixel-identical reconstruction.

intent: Deliver the authorized 30-second visual-replication test with an editable project.
method: Native Blender rendering, FFmpeg muxing, full decode and format verification, numerical audio checks, and sampled visual review of exported frames.
result: Final file is exactly 900 frames / 30 seconds at 1920x1080 and 30 fps, stereo 48 kHz. Integrated loudness -17.34 LUFS; true peak -2.00 dBTP. Reviewed a 30-frame overview plus 16 pickup and 16 retreat samples. The Blender project packs fonts and soundtrack; previous films remain unchanged.
decision: Ready for user assessment of resemblance and timing. No subjective listening review, audience test, or publication performed.
